notes.title: Release date 29th of April 2025!
notes.notes:
🧙‍♂️✨ Prepare Your Spells – Spellslayer Launches April 29, 2025!

We’re thrilled to announce that Spellslayer will officially launch on April 29th, 2025!

Spellslayer is a tactical roguelike where every battle is a strategic puzzle. You’ll play as a spellcasting mage locked in high-stakes, turn-based combat on a tight, grid-based battlefield. The twist? Every enemy potential move is telegraphed before your turn, giving you just enough time to dodge, plan, and counter—if you’re clever enough.

🌀 Think ahead. Cast fast. Survive the spellstorm.

🔮 Core Features:

Fast-paced tactical gameplay with tight roguelike runs

Enemies telegraph their actions—can you outwit them?

A deep arsenal of spells to collect, combine, and master

Grid-based combat that rewards foresight and positioning

Unique enemies, challenging boss fights, and powerful upgrades

Replayability that keeps every run fresh

Whether you're a fan of roguelikes, strategy games, or magical duels with a twist, Spellslayer has something for you.

📅 Mark your calendars: April 29, 2025
💫 Wishlist now and be ready to enter the spell arena!
